The choice of the conference room was made to ensure privacy rather than to harass or discriminate against the complainant, with management selecting this location specifically because it was removed from the main work area.

Additionally, the complainant raises concerns regarding the composition of the reviewing parties, questioning whether impartial justice is possible given that both Agency counsel and the AJ are Caucasian.
The Agency maintains its position that the final order should be affirmed, arguing that the summary judgment was properly granted and no hearing was necessary.
